dataset: American Community Survey Public Use Microdata Sample (acs/acs1/pums)

variables.NP: Number of persons in this household

notes: PUMS is a sample of person records; weighted cell counts estimate population counts with sampling error that is not computed here (no replicate weights).
Missing values in grouping columns are kept as their own cell; their meaning is the variable's universe in the PUMS data dictionary.
Records kept inside AGEP in [19, 64], POVPIP in [0, 199].
Coarsened AGEP, SCHL, NP, ESR into bands labelled by lower edge.
Pooled 39 state(s): each cell's weight and record count were summed across states before the small-cell floor was applied.
Aggregated to 3152 cell(s) from 289644 person record(s); 1264 cell(s) with fewer than 10 records were withheld (5485 record(s), weighted 617,553). No person-level row is returned.
